declared difference (issue #966 items 1 and 3): a swallowing catch followed by a lastOk* stamp that is behind an
if/else (a, b), a ?: (c), && (d), || (e), at another brace depth (f, g) is not the swallowed-failure shape, and a
handler that hands back Promise.reject(e) (h, i), throws (j) or returns on a path (k) is a rethrow.

-- args --
@DIR@
-- want --
exit 0
-- stderr --
-- a-if.js --
let lastOkAt = 0;
async function poll() {
  try {
    await load();
  } catch (err) {
    paint("error");
  }
  if (ready) lastOkAt = Date.now();
  if (Date.now() - lastOkAt > 3e4) location.reload();
}
setTimeout(poll, 5000);
-- b-else.js --
let lastOkAt = 0;
async function poll() {
  try {
    await load();
  } catch (err) {
    paint("error");
  }
  if (stale) go(); else lastOkAt = Date.now();
  if (Date.now() - lastOkAt > 3e4) location.reload();
}
setTimeout(poll, 5000);
-- c-ternary.js --
let lastOkAt = 0;
async function poll() {
  try {
    await load();
  } catch (err) {
    paint("error");
  }
  ok ? (lastOkAt = Date.now()) : 0;
  if (Date.now() - lastOkAt > 3e4) location.reload();
}
setTimeout(poll, 5000);
-- d-and.js --
let lastOkAt = 0;
async function poll() {
  try {
    await load();
  } catch (err) {
    paint("error");
  }
  ready && (lastOkAt = Date.now());
  if (Date.now() - lastOkAt > 3e4) location.reload();
}
setTimeout(poll, 5000);
-- e-or.js --
let lastOkAt = 0;
async function poll() {
  try {
    await load();
  } catch (err) {
    paint("error");
  }
  cached || (lastOkAt = Date.now());
  if (Date.now() - lastOkAt > 3e4) location.reload();
}
setTimeout(poll, 5000);
-- f-other-depth.js --
let lastOkAt = 0;
async function poll() {
  try {
    await load();
  } catch (err) {
    paint("error");
  }
  {
    lastOkAt = Date.now();
  }
  if (Date.now() - lastOkAt > 3e4) location.reload();
}
setTimeout(poll, 5000);
-- g-nested-function.js --
let lastOkAt = 0;
async function poll() {
  try {
    await load();
  } catch (err) {
    paint("error");
  }
  function later() {
    lastOkAt = Date.now();
  }
  if (Date.now() - lastOkAt > 3e4) location.reload();
}
setTimeout(poll, 5000);
-- h-promise-reject.js --
let lastOkAt = 0;
async function poll() {
  await load().catch(e => Promise.reject(e));
  lastOkAt = Date.now();
  if (Date.now() - lastOkAt > 3e4) location.reload();
}
setTimeout(poll, 5000);
-- i-block-promise-reject.js --
let lastOkAt = 0;
async function poll() {
  await load().catch(e => { return Promise.reject(e); });
  lastOkAt = Date.now();
  if (Date.now() - lastOkAt > 3e4) location.reload();
}
setTimeout(poll, 5000);
-- j-function-throw.js --
let lastOkAt = 0;
async function poll() {
  await load().catch(function (e) { throw e; });
  lastOkAt = Date.now();
  if (Date.now() - lastOkAt > 3e4) location.reload();
}
setTimeout(poll, 5000);
-- k-conditional-return.js --
let lastOkAt = 0;
async function poll() {
  await load().catch(e => { if (fatal) { return Promise.reject(e); } paint("error"); });
  lastOkAt = Date.now();
  if (Date.now() - lastOkAt > 3e4) location.reload();
}
setTimeout(poll, 5000);
